title: DC5 Electric Dryer
sub: Matte black, electric, 7.0 cu. ft., steam
lead: The DC5 is the dryer made to stand beside the TC5 washer, in matte black. Six cycles on a dial, Steam Boost and Steam Refresh, Pet Plus cycles, and a moisture sensor that stops the heat when the load is dry. Backed for five years, parts and labor.

features.name: Steam Boost and Steam Refresh
features.line: Steam Boost works on wrinkles and static during a cycle. Steam Refresh freshens what was worn once and does not need a wash.

features.name: Dries to the sensor, not the clock
features.line: A moisture sensor ends the cycle when the load is dry, and Speed Queen's Commercial Cool-Down brings the temperature down before the drum stops.

features.name: Pet Plus cycles
features.line: Cycles made for pet bedding and blankets, with one for removing pet hair.

features.name: Six cycles on a dial
features.line: Six preset cycles and four temperatures, Sanitize among them, set with a turn on a panel styled to match the TC5 washer beside it.

features.name: Five years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the DC5 with a 5-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

also: Extended Tumble, which keeps the load moving after the cycle ends
Up-front lint filter with a filter guard
